purpose: Pinned B0 exterior composition and later two-API acceptance inputs. CPU preview is not runtime reference ground truth.

coordinate_system.projection: Perspective, vertical FOV; logical top-left output; normal-Z zero-to-one depth (near 0, far 1); backend conversion must preserve rays and front faces.

views.name: overview
views.purpose: Whole exterior fits camera frustum with margin; target is a virtual aim point below ground, not a camera position. Occlusion still applies.

views.name: street
views.purpose: Street, sun/shadow boundary, building materials and foliage.

views.name: material-detail
views.purpose: Vespa, normal/roughness and pavement near-field detail.

views.name: glass-detail
views.purpose: Alpha-zero glass and curtains behind; no diagnostic fill.

views.name: label-detail
views.purpose: Alpha-zero labels and bottle behind; no diagnostic fill.

route.interpolation: Linear position, target and vertical FOV between named keyframes, +Y look-at up.
route.collision: No collision or walking-physics requirement; composition/clearance audit recorded separately.

sun.units: Scene-linear benchmark irradiance; not measured lux or calibrated daylight.

preprocess.formula: c=max(decoded linear RGB,0); L=dot(c,coefficients); c*=min(1,cap/max(L,1e-20)); source texels before resampling/prefilter, then strength. Bright-source suppression, not physical sun removal.

ibl.mapping: u=fract(0.5+atan2(direction.z,direction.x)/(2*pi)); v=acos(clamp(direction.y,-1,1))/pi; source top row v=0; sample inverse R_y(yaw)*direction; repeat U, clamp V.
ibl.prefilter: B3 generates diffuse irradiance, roughness-dependent specular and BRDF integration from processed source; tool and output hashes fixed before B3 acceptance.

output.order: Linear HDR -> external Bloom if enabled -> multiply by 2^exposure_ev -> PBR Neutral -> sRGB OETF exactly once -> RGB8 round nearest, alpha 1.
output.background: Constant camera-visible background, processed with same exposure/tone/sRGB; IBL stays visible to illumination and reflections.

preview.note: Cycles CPU composition/exposure diagnostic with denoised visualization and separately retained noisy EXR; not matching runtime PBR/IBL/CSM/Bloom/AA. No native depth/shadow acceptance or performance claims.
preview.denoiser: OpenImageDenoise, CPU compositor, accurate HDR with normal/albedo guides; independent noisy EXR retained

runtime_quality.pbr: Metallic-roughness GGX and Lambert diffuse with normal maps; audited AO/alpha/double-sided recipe retained. Details fixed with selected B0 foundation.
runtime_quality.shadow: CSM+PCF starting profile: 4 cascades, 2048 square each, distance 120m, practical split lambda .6, 3x3 PCF, texel snapping, last 10% blend. Bias calibrated B3 before acceptance.
runtime_quality.hdr: RGBA16F starting profile; actual format usages checked on both APIs.
runtime_quality.aa: FXAA starting profile after tone mapping before sRGB, AA-off diagnostics; parameters fixed/calibrated B3.
runtime_quality.bloom: External effect on for B5 final output, bypass also saved; threshold/knee/radius/strength fixed B4 before acceptance.

acceptance.scope: Full exterior, no mesh/material silently omitted. Indoor/GI/path tracing/native HDR display not required.
acceptance.cpu_preview: Composition/exposure only. Runtime image thresholds cannot derive from these noisy previews.
acceptance.gpu_comparison: Optimized strict-validation and optimized no-diagnostics/no-native-validation runs; Vulkan/D3D12 sequential on Windows RTX3060. Save SDR, pre-Bloom HDR, depth, shadow and Bloom bypass at named views and scheduled route frames.
acceptance.threshold_calibration: Before each acceptance: same API >=3 repeats, both APIs and known material/sRGB/alpha/shadow errors; freeze absolute/relative RGB/HDR, differing-pixel count and named ROI thresholds with settings hash. Retain edge pixels, fail shape/NaN/inf. Numeric thresholds await B2/B3/B5 GPU calibration.
acceptance.performance: Cold first-load separate; 2 complete 1800-frame warm-up tours then 3 measured 1800-frame tours at 60Hz logical time (30s scene time each; wall duration is measured, not forced to 30s). Offscreen VSync off; raw samples and per-run p50/p95, no fixed FPS budget before RTX3060 measurement. CPU build/compile/record/submit/retire, GPU timestamps, frame wall time, memory residency/high-water/budget; present/VSync measured separately.
acceptance.alpha_note: Label view remains naturally dark with no interior/fill lighting. Its CPU color preview is not evidence of zero depth/shadow coverage; require explicit GPU depth/shadow and opaque-override sensitivity fixtures in B2/B3.
